task: 3. Extend the install manifest into the authoritative split-package schema
evidence_type: mutation — validation detects collisions and orphans

validation_tests.name: validate_split_manifest_passes_for_valid_manifest
validation_tests.given: a manifest with package ownership on every entry and no path collisions

validation_tests.name: validate_split_manifest_detects_collision_between_file_and_dir
validation_tests.given: a manifest where a file dest equals a dir path with a different package
validation_tests.then: returns a ValidationError::Collision for that path

validation_tests.name: validate_split_manifest_detects_duplicate_file_dest
validation_tests.given: a manifest with two [[files]] entries having the same dest but different packages
validation_tests.then: returns a ValidationError::Collision for the duplicate dest

validation_tests.name: validate_split_manifest_detects_orphan_entry_without_package
validation_tests.given: a manifest with a [[files]] entry missing the package field
validation_tests.then: returns a ValidationError::Orphan for that entry's dest

validation_tests.name: validate_split_manifest_detects_orphan_generated_state_without_package
validation_tests.given: a manifest with a [[generated_state]] entry missing the package field
validation_tests.then: returns a ValidationError::Orphan for that entry's path

validation_tests.name: repo_manifest_has_package_ownership_on_every_entry
validation_tests.when: every file and dir entry is checked for package.is_some()

validation_tests.name: repo_manifest_gnome_package_has_no_kde_payload
validation_tests.given: the real manifest, GNOME package dests filtered
validation_tests.when: each GNOME file path is checked for kde/qt6/qml/kpackage indicators
validation_tests.then: no GNOME file contains KDE/Qt payload

validation_tests.name: repo_manifest_kde_package_has_no_gnome_payload
validation_tests.given: the real manifest, KDE package dests filtered
validation_tests.when: each KDE file path is checked for wizard/gnome/gtk/adwaita indicators
validation_tests.then: no KDE file contains GNOME/GTK payload
